0022600007.text: Neither the Oklahoma City Thunder nor the Denver Nuggets has played a 2026-27 game yet, and the Thunder are without Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery). Denver is missing Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), while Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring issue and is a game-time decision. The Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, but Denver won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season between the two teams.
